name: Baked Hoisin Drumsticks with Sesame Romaine & Carrot Salad
instructions: Place hoisin sauce, water, soy sauce, and oil in a large baking dish; stir to combine the sauce.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels, add to the dish with the sauce, and turn to coat.
Place dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning halfway through, until chicken is cooked through, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the chicken is almost done, place dressing, additional oil, and sesame seeds in a large bowl. Stir to combine the dressing.
Wash, dry, and halve lettuce lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with carrots, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chicken and salad between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
